name: continuous-improvement
description: Ambition and discipline for coding agents: the be-ambitious skill and a seven-step loop. A hook denies known destructive shell commands. Opt-in hooks deny pushes to protected branches and edits to the files that wire the guardrails, and hold a turn open on a failing typecheck. Tool calls go to a local searchable log; saved lessons load at session start. Ships 29 bundled skills and an MCP server.
author: naimkatiman
